item.title: Version 1.3.2
item.description:
Surge Browser 1.3.2

Surge is the browser you own, and now it looks it: the Google links and buttons that came with the browser engine are gone, and your saved passwords stay on your Mac.

  • No more Google links and buttons. Help links to Google's support site, Translate, "Send to your device" and the in-page image search are gone from menus and pages. Image search still works from the search box on your new tab page.
  • Your passwords stay on your Mac. Password Manager no longer offers to save your passwords in a Google Account, and its Google-run password Checkup is gone. Any passwords that were set to sync to Google are copied to this Mac when you update, so nothing is lost.
